release.content: publet-cli 0.3.0 was released on 2026-11-02 from commit f3a9ed2337f6c22b042a12b548ec4af046986af0 with these changes.

rows: The repository moved to the Sustenaut organization; its links and repository URL name Sustenaut/publet
Update other crates the supply-chain audits cover
Update other crates the supply-chain audits cover

PDC families and editions: `defines` sorts `family` and `edition`, `pub bundle` name bundles pointing at a family and a code, generation records signed by the publishing key, definitions at a PDC code that change by `supersedes` and refuse disputes, support and judgement, and a load that reports and leaves out an inadmissible object instead of failing

A dispute, support, assessment, verdict or critique aimed at a concept is now refused, as on a family or edition, where it was accepted before. A plumbing command or `pub` loading a directory or store that holds a refused verdict or similar object no longer exits 1: it leaves the object out, warns on stderr and goes on, so its stdout and exit code change. `pub publish` and, where a key is held, `pub domain` write a signature beside each generation record

A first publish or an advance too large for one generation record is now stated across several consecutive signed records, each inside the 64 KiB object limit. One record of more than about 970 members could be written but not read back, which stopped the next `pub publish` and `pub bundle --dir`
The object size limit is now 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB), up from 65,536, for objects and for the frames of a pack. An older build refuses a larger object
